newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Petrobras OKs $250 mln samurai bond.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Petrobras OKs $250 mln samurai bond.

text.p: Shareholders of Brazilian state oil monopoly Petrobras approved Thursday the issue $250 million in debt denominated in Japanese yen, a company official said.
The Petrobras spokesman said Daiwa Securities would lead-manage the issue of so-called samurai bonds. He did not give the maturity, interest or other details.
Local InvestNews news agency reported the bonds would have a maturity of six years and bear a 4.3 percent annual rate.
The samurai bonds would be the first of a total of between $500 million and $600 million in debt the company plans to issue in 1997 to fund new investments.
Petrobras, which plans to invest $30 billion betwen 1996 and 2000, raised $500 million on the Eurobond market. Officials also said the firm was preparing to list its stock on U.S. markets.
